assigned.title: Subtitle selection policy
assigned.acceptance: Preferred language, forced, default, and off policies are explicit and tested

typecheck.evidence: turbo run typecheck plus npm run check, exit 0 under pinned Node 22, on the tree committed this round; media-engine compiles with the new withSelectedAudio, SubtitleOutcome and SUBTITLE_OUTCOME_BY_REASON exports

unit.evidence: vitest via npm run check, exit 0, on the tree committed this round; adds subtitle cases and three properties covering bidirectional bare/regional BCP-47 matching, es-419, off-beats-isDefault, the 13-key outcome table, a one-character audio tag treated as unknown, and a composition running the real selectAudioTrack

recommended.title: Candidate failover policy
recommended.acceptance: Retry and fallback behavior is bounded, deterministic, observable, and testable

recommended.title: Unknown media metadata semantics
recommended.acceptance: StreamCandidate can represent genuinely unknown videoCodec, audioCodec, height and bitrateKbps, and the media engine treats unknown as unknown rather than as a value: eligibility must not pass on an unverified codec, and scoring must not award or penalise a fabricated number

recommended.title: Channel and EPG contracts
recommended.acceptance: Licensed channel, program, schedule, and EPG contracts are typed and documented
